name: synarc-universal
description: Universal skill pack for engineering intelligence across all AI coding agents

scripts.check-vendor-lockin: pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { $violations = 0; $patterns = @(@{Pattern='activation: (contextual|automatic)'; Issue='Platform-specific activation'},@{Pattern='parent: '; Issue='Claude plugin inheritance'},@{Pattern='cache: '; Issue='Platform-specific caching'},@{Pattern='^compatibility:'; Issue='Deprecated compatibility field'},@{Pattern='minimumVersion:'; Issue='Deprecated version field'}); Get-ChildItem -Path skills -Recurse -Filter 'SKILL.md' | ForEach-Object { $content = Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw; foreach ($rule in $patterns) { if ($content -match $rule.Pattern) { Write-Warning \"$($_.FullName): $($rule.Issue)\"; $violations++ } } }; if ($violations -gt 0) { Write-Error \"Found $violations violations\"; exit 1 }; Write-Host 'No vendor lock-in violations' }"
scripts.check-refs: pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { $broken = 0; Get-ChildItem -Path skills -Recurse -Filter 'SKILL.md' | ForEach-Object { $dir = $_.DirectoryName; $content = Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw; $refs = [regex]::Matches($content, '\[.*?\]\(([^)]+)\)'); foreach ($ref in $refs) { $target = $ref.Groups[1].Value; if ($target -notmatch '^https?://') { $resolved = Join-Path $dir $target; if (-not (Test-Path $resolved)) { Write-Warning \"Broken ref: $($_.FullName) -> $target\"; $broken++ } } } }; if ($broken -gt 0) { Write-Error \"Found $broken broken refs\"; exit 1 }; Write-Host 'All references valid' }"
scripts.lint: npm run check-vendor-lockin && npm run check-refs
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run test-fallbacks
scripts.build: npm run generate-manifest && npm run validate
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run test
